title: Opening Fish All Day
lead: Your download has started. This hackathon release is signed but not yet notarised by Apple, so a macOS warning on first launch is expected.
safe: Notarisation requires a paid Apple Developer account and an identity check. This release does not have these yet.
No internet connections. Everything it shows and plays is inside the app.
No permissions requested for files, screen recording, camera, microphone, contacts or accessibility.
Only your fish count and voice setting are saved, in the app’s own preferences.
No payments, accounts or tracking. The “Give him $5” button charges nothing.
steps: Open the downloaded Fish-All-Day.dmg and drag Fish All Day into Applications.
Open Fish All Day from Applications to see "Apple could not verify “Fish All Day” is free of malware". Click "Done", not "Move to Trash".

Open "System Settings" → "Privacy & Security" and scroll down to "Security". Find "“Fish All Day” was blocked to protect your Mac", click "Open Anyway", then confirm "Open Anyway" with your password or Touch ID.
Uncle Farter walks onto your Dock. You only do this once; after that, the app opens normally.
older: On macOS 13 or 14, right-click the app, choose "Open", then click "Open".
foot: Requires macOS 13 Ventura or later on an Apple silicon Mac (M1 or newer).
